d: Naee dilli men aaj se do divsiy bharat krishi sammelan ka aayojan kiya ja raha hai, pradhanmantri narendr modi sammelan ko sanbodhit karenge, is aayojan men deshbhar ke kisan, niti nirmata, krishi vaigyanik aur udyog jagat ke pratinidhi shamil ho rahe hain. vahin, aadivasi netri nisha bhagat ki maut ke mamle men aaropiyon ki giraphtari ki mang ko lekar bhajpa anusuchit janjati morcha ne kaindal march nikala, jabki ebivipi ki or se bhi rajy sarkar ke khilaph pradarshan karte hue putla dahan kiya gaya. idhar, jharkhand ekedmik kaunsil yani jaik ki or se maitrik aur intarmidiet pariksha 2027…
